fullDescription: The Nova Sunset Light Variant is a warm, energetic, and professional SaaS dashboard design. It features a sophisticated 'sunset' color palette of orange and amber accents set against a soft cream-white background. Optimized for AI learning platforms, research tools, fintech, and knowledge management systems, the design utilizes a fixed left sidebar and a high-legibility bento-grid layout. Key characteristics include Satoshi typography, subtle 3D transforms on cards, and soft-glow input fields that enhance the user focus during deep work sessions.

structured.summary: A clean, warm-toned light-mode dashboard for AI-driven workspaces. It uses a sunset-inspired orange-to-amber gradient for primary actions and active states, balanced by a minimal cream-white base and soft, elegant shadows.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'Sunset Light' aesthetic: a mix of cream backgrounds (#f8f7f5) and high-energy orange gradients. Typography uses the 'Satoshi' font family for a modern, geometric look. Icons are thin-line Lucide variants, and interactive elements feature micro-interactions like 2px vertical translations and subtle shadow expansions. Color palette: Cream White (#fcfcfb), Page Background (#f8f7f5), Primary Orange (#ea580c), Amber Glow (#f59e0b), and Soft Gray Text (#6b7280).
style.prompt:
### Visual Language & Branding
- **Base Color Palette**: 
  - Page Background: `#f8f7f5` (Cream)
  - Sidebar/Card Background: `#fcfcfb` (Pure White-Cream)
  - Primary Accent: Gradient from `#ea580c` to `#f59e0b` at 135 degrees.
  - Secondary Accents: `#fff7ed` (Light Orange tint for active states), `#ea580c` (Strong Orange for icons).
  - Neutral Text: High emphasis `#1f2937` (Gray 800), Low emphasis `#9ca3af` (Gray 400).

- **Typography**: 
  - Primary Font: 'Satoshi' (or any high-quality geometric Sans-serif).
  - Headers: 3xl (30px) or xl (20px), Font-weight 700 (Bold), Letter-spacing -0.025em.
  - Body: Sm (14px), Font-weight 500 (Medium).
  - Metadata: 10px, Font-weight 800 (Extrabold), Uppercase, Tracking-widest (0.1em).

- **Effects & Depth**: 
  - Soft Shadows: `box-shadow: 0 2px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)`.
  - Hover State: `translateY(-2px)` with shadow expansion `0 10px 25px -5px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.1)`.
  - Focus State: `box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.08)` and border tint `rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.3)`.

- **Animations**: 
  - Standard: `transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`.
  - Buttons: `scale(1.02)` on hover, `scale(0.95)` on active click.

layout_and_structure.description: A two-column layout featuring a fixed 280px sidebar on the left and a fluid, center-aligned main content area constrained to 1200px. The main content is divided into a header, an oversized search/input hero, a quick action grid, and a document library.

prompts.prompt: Fixed 280px width, full height. Background `#fcfcfb`. Border-right `1px solid rgba(229, 231, 235, 0.6)`. Top section includes a brand logo (32px icon in orange gradient) and a search bar with 10px padding and orange ring on focus. Navigation items are rounded-xl (12px), active state uses background `#fff7ed`, text `#ea580c`, and a 3px right border-indicator. Bottom section includes a 'Pro Plan' promo card in `#fff7ed` with an orange-700 button and a user profile row with a circular 40px avatar and online status indicator.

Flex container with space-between. Left side: 30px Bold title 'Welcome back, [User]' and 14px date string with a highlighted 'Time Spent' metric in orange. Right side: Action group containing square 44px notification button and a pill-shaped history button with Lucide icons.

Main container with 3xl rounded corners (24px), background white, and soft-shadow. Top area: Large 18px textarea with minimal border, placeholder text `#d1d5db`. Bottom area: Toolbar with a row of source-type buttons (PDF, Video, Web) using colored icons (Orange, Red, Blue) and bold 10px uppercase labels. Right-aligned primary button: Gradient accent, 14px Bold text, 'Analyze Knowledge' label, 14px padding vertical, 32px padding horizontal.

4-column grid for desktop. Each item: 24px rounded card, white background, vertical centered flex layout. 44px rounded-xl icon containers using light background tints (Orange-50, Blue-50, Purple-50, Emerald-50). On hover: Icon container scales 1.1x and card border changes to match the icon color tint.

3-column grid of 24px rounded cards. Each card includes: 40px icon top-left, 'More' vertical dots top-right. Bold 16px title. Metadata row with small gray text. Bottom row: Overlapping avatar-style circles for 'Tags/Features' and a right-aligned 'Time Ago' stamp in 10px extrabold uppercase.

special_ui_components.description: A high-impact CTA button with a specific gradient and shadow profile.
special_ui_components.prompt: Width: fit-content; Padding: 14px 32px; Background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ea580c 0%, #f59e0b 100%); Border-radius: 16px; Font-weight: 700; Color: white; Text-transform: uppercase; Letter-spacing: 1px; Box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.2); Transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; Hover: transform scale(1.02), shadow-lg.

special_ui_components.description: A search/text area that feels 'alive' when active.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container background: white; Border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; Radius: 24px; Transition: all 0.3s; Focus-within: border-color: rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.3), shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.08). The internal textarea must be borderless with a height of 100px-150px.

structured.special_notes: MUST maintain the high-contrast between the soft cream backgrounds and the vivid orange interactive elements. DO NOT use sharp black (#000000); use Gray-800 (#1f2937) for headers and Gray-500 (#6b7280) for body text. All container corners should be generously rounded (at least 24px for main sections).
